ya5.3.4:1.1: yo dukkhasaccaṃ parijānāti so samudayasaccaṃ pajahitthāti: no.
ya5.3.4:2.1: yo vā pana samudayasaccaṃ pajahittha so dukkhasaccaṃ parijānātīti: no
ya5.3.4:3.1: yo dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānāti so samudayasaccaṃ na pajahitthāti:
ya5.3.4:4.1: arahā dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānāti, no ca samudayasaccaṃ na pajahittha. aggamaggasamaṅgiñca arahantañca ṭhapetvā avasesā puggalā dukkhasaccañca na parijānanti, samudayasaccañca na pajahittha.
ya5.3.4:5.1: yo vā pana samudayasaccaṃ na pajahittha so dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānātīti:
ya5.3.4:6.1: aggamaggasamaṅgī samudayasaccaṃ na pajahittha, no ca dukkhasaccaṃ na parijānāti. aggamaggasamaṅgiñca arahantañca ṭhapetvā avasesā puggalā samudayasaccañca na pajahittha, dukkhasaccañca na parijānanti. paccuppannātītavāro.
